summary: Every mail comes from one sender, changing the sender works, and the send right is checked every day.

fixes.title: One sender for every mail
fixes.text: Every mail now comes from the one sender mailbox, also through an SMTP relay. The separate SMTP from address is gone; an existing one is moved into the sender once, so no mail stops.

fixes.title: Changing the sender works
fixes.text: The mail setup checks that the right for a new mailbox works before it switches (Exchange can take up to 2 hours), then removes the right for the old one. If it does not work, the old sender stays.

fixes.title: The send right checked every day
fixes.text: Once a day Entra Policy Suite checks that it may send as the sender mailbox and as no other one - without sending anything - and reports the result.
